import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.PriorityQueue;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, f, cap, cost, rev;
    }

    static class MCF {
        int n, m, k, t;
        int[] u, v, prio, curflow, prevedge, prevnode, pot;
        Edge[][] adj;

        public MCF(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            u = new int[n];
            v = new int[n];
            prio = new int[n];
            curflow = new int[n];
            prevedge = new int[n];
            prevnode = new int[n];
            pot = new int[n];
            adj = new Edge[n][];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj[i] = new Edge[0];
            }
        }

        PriorityQueue<Long> q;

        public void addEdge(int s, int t, int cap, int cost) {
            Edge a = new Edge();
            a.to = t;
            a.f = 0;
            a.cap = cap;
            a.cost = cost;
            a.rev = adj[t].length;
            Edge b = new Edge();
            b.to = s;
            b.f = 0;
            b.cap = 0;
            b.cost = -cost;
            b.rev = adj[s].length;
            int[] newAdjS = new Edge[adj[s].length + 1];
            System.arraycopy(adj[s], 0, newAdjS, 0, adj[s].length);
            newAdjS[adj[s].length] = a;
            adj[s] = newAdjS;
            int[] newAdjT = new Edge[adj[t].length + 1];
            System.arraycopy(adj[t], 0, newAdjT, 0, adj[t].length);
            newAdjT[adj[t].length] = b;
            adj[t] = newAdjT;
        }

        public Pair minCostFlow(int s, int t) {
            int flow = 0;
            int flowCost = 0;
            while (flow < Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                q = new PriorityQueue<>((x, y) -> Long.compare(y >> 32, x >> 32));
                q.add((long) 0 << 32 | s);
                fill(prio, 0, prio.length, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                prio[s] = 0;
                curflow[s] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                    long cur = q.peek();
                    int d = (int) (cur >> 32);
                    int u = (int) cur;
                    q.poll();
                    if (d != prio[u])
                        continue;
                    for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                        int v = e.to;
                        if (e.cap <= e.f)
                            continue;
                        int nprio = prio[u] + e.cost + pot[u] - pot[v];
                        if (prio[v] > nprio) {
                            prio[v] = nprio;
                            q.add((long) nprio << 32 | v);
                            prevnode[v] = u;
                            prevedge[v] = adj[v].length - 1;
                            curflow[v] = Math.min(curflow[u], e.cap - e.f);
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (prio[t] == Integer.MAX_VALUE)
                    break;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                    pot[i] += prio[i];
                int df = Math.min(curflow[t], Integer.MAX_VALUE - flow);
                flow += df;
                for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevnode[v]) {
                    Edge e = adj[prevnode[v]][prevedge[v]];
                    e.f += df;
                    adj[v][e.rev].f -= df;
                    flowCost += df * e.cost;
                }
            }
            return new Pair(flow, flowCost);
        }
    }

    static class Pair {
        int first;
        int second;

        public Pair(int first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        MCF nt = new MCF(6 + 107 * n);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            x--;
            nt.addEdge(0, 1 + x, 1, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int y = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            x--;
            y--;
            for (int j = 0; j < 105; j++) {
                for (int l = 0; l < 51; l++) {
                    nt.addEdge(1 + j * n + x, 1 + (j + 1) * n + y, 1, c + d * (2 * l + 1));
                    nt.addEdge(1 + j * n + y, 1 + (j + 1) * n + x, 1, c + d * (2 * l + 1));
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 105; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                nt.addEdge(1 + i * n + j, 1 + (i + 1) * n + j, 51, c);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 105; i++) {
            nt.addEdge(1 + i * n, 1 + 105 * n, 51, 0);
        }
        Pair ans = nt.minCostFlow(0, 1 + 105 * n);
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        pw.println(ans.second);
        pw.close();
    }
}
